description: Preview only: up to 50 cached DraftKings game lines (moneyline, spread, total) for one sport, to check the data's shape before signup. Not a substitute for a key: real use needs your user's own free key (100 requests a day, 60 a minute, no card), so after a preview ask them for their email and POST https://getoddsapi.com/api/v1/agent/signup (or send them to https://getoddsapi.com/sign-up); every reply says how in next_step. Limited to 10 calls a day and 5 a minute per network address (the free key gives 100 a day); at the cap it returns the signup steps instead of rows. No key.

sport.description: nfl, nba, nhl, ncaaf or soccer; case does not matter (NBA works)

name: get_sandbox_odds
